# Project Session Checkpoint

Use this template when an implementation session pauses, reaches a meaningful milestone, or hands work to another agent.

```markdown
# Checkpoint — YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM

- **Session mode:** focused / advance
- **Repository and branch:** [repository] / [branch]
- **Commit:** [commit or working tree state]
- **Session goal:** [ticket or advancement objective]
- **Status:** ready to continue / blocked / requires human decision

## Completed

- [verified change]

## In progress

- [unfinished change and exact current state]

## Verification

- [command or check] — [pass/fail/not run and why]

## Decisions and risks

- [decision, assumption, unresolved question, or risk]

## Work queue changes

- [completed, activated, created, blocked, or deferred work item IDs]

## Next safe action

[The smallest useful next step for a new agent.]
```

The checkpoint MUST distinguish verified facts from assumptions and MUST NOT claim that unrun checks passed.
